system.effect:
You are Trained in this fighting style: its exploits are open to you, and checks its talents call for use this Constellation's Proficiency. Attack rolls themselves use your Weapons Proficiency.
You gain the Draw a Bead ◆ action.
Draw a Bead ◆ (concentrate)
Choose one creature you can Observe and can reach with your bow.
Until the end of your turn: your next bow Strike against that creature gains a +1 circumstance bonus to the attack; ignore the weapon's Unwieldy penalty for that Strike; if that Strike Grazes, you choose the Zone that becomes Exposed instead of the defender. Every talent here requires this.
